prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Quick Reference Screen: Adds a static quick reference screen after home intro showing fundamental desktop pet mouse controls.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_controls_reference"], "new_controls_reference": {"headline": "Desktop Pet Controls", "body": "Right-click your pet anytime to open settings, feed them, or temporarily send them to sleep.", "layout": "card"}}
1: [adoption, redesign] Grid Layout for Pet Friend Selection: Redesigns the pet selection screen layout into a clean grid view displaying available companions side-by-side.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Companion"}}
2: [home, new_flow] Pre-Hatch Desktop Tips Wait Screen: Adds an informational tips screen right before the main waiting screen to set expectations while generation takes place.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "new_pre_wait_info", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pre_wait_info": {"headline": "Preparing Your Pet Workspace", "body": "Your companion will appear seamlessly over your open desktop windows once generation completes.", "layout": "centered"}}
3: [choose_path, redesign] Two Column Path Selection Layout: Redesigns the choose_path screen into a two-column comparison card layout.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Select Your Adoption Method"}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Sync Explanation Hint: Adds explicit hint text on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in syncs pet state safely to cloud storage.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in connects your desktop pet data to your cloud account so your pet is never lost."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Background Wait Desktop Notification Toggle: Enables background desktop notifications on the waiting screen with clarifying helper copy.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "You can minimize this window. We will send a system notification when your pet is ready!"}}
6: [choose_path, copy] Story Screen Value Copy Refresh: Updates story screen text to emphasize low-overhead background desktop companionship.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Meet Your Virtual Desktop Buddy", "body": "A lightweight companion that sits on your taskbar and keeps you company while you work or game."}}
7: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Best Practices Hint: Adds a hint on the photo upload screen recommending clear front-facing lighting for pet customization.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For optimal results, upload a well-lit, front-facing photo without crowded backgrounds."}}
8: [finish, copy] Desktop Visibility Reassurance Copy: Updates home_intro headline and hint reassuring users where on their monitor to look for their pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Companion Has Arrived!", "hint": "Check the corner of your desktop screen to see your new pet floating over your apps."}}
9: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Troubleshooting Guidance: Adds explicit troubleshooting helper copy to the sign-in screen body.
   config: {"sign_in": {"body": "Sign in to save your pet progress. If the login popup does not open, check your system browser settings."}}

verdicts.reason: Adding a controls quick reference screen after home intro inside onboarding complies with all rules.
Redesigning the pet selection layout to a grid preserves the screen's core job.
Adding an informational pre-wait screen before waiting is a permitted addition within onboarding.
Redesigning choose_path into a two-column layout preserves the functionality of choosing a path.
Adding a cloud sync hint to the sign-in screen is compliant with all rules.
Adding background notification toggles and helper text on the wait screen is allowed.
Updating story copy to describe the desktop companion maintains the role of introducing the pet.
Adding best practice guidance to the photo upload screen is compliant.
Updating home_intro text to guide the user on locating their desktop pet is allowed.
Adding troubleshooting helper text to the sign-in screen complies with all base rules.
